rows.abstract: "Health Care Delivery Modernization Act of 1998". rows.abstract: This proposal will definitely contribute  in promoting the morale and welfare of AFP personnel and will further enhance the efficiency in the performance of their duties.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-11-12

rows.author: A032
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE QUARTER ALLOWANCE OF OFFICERS AND ENLISTED PERSONNEL OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: The author explains that the present rate of quarter allowances given to military personnel is NOT adequate to enable them to have decent quarters.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE since 1998-11-12

rows.author: A032
rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE RATE OF BASE PAY OF OFFICERS AND ENLISTED PERSONNEL OF THE ARMED FORCES OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.abstract: Through this proposal, AFP personnel's base pay shall be at par with PNP personnel's base pay.  The living condition of military personnel shall likewise be improved with their increased net take-home pay.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on NATIONAL DEFENSE since 1998-11-12

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTIONS 4 AND 6, PARAGRAPH (C) OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 6972, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE "BARANGAY-LEVEL TOTAL DEVELOPMENT AND PROTECTION OF CHILDREN ACT", AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES(RE: ALLOWANCES OF DAY CARE WORKERS; CREATION OF A POSITION INEVERY BARANGAY)
rows.abstract: Seeks to INCREASE the allowance of day care workers to TWO THOUSAND PESOS (P2,000.00). Mandates the creation of one (1) barangay day care worker position in every barangay.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-11-12

rows.author: C006
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR EDUCATIONAL BENEFITS FOR THE MINOR CHILDREN OR DEPENDENTS OF LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS WHO ARE KILLED BY INSURGENTS OR SLAIN IN THE LINE OF DUTY, PROVIDING FUNDS THEREFOR AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Benefits provided under this bill include (1) tuition fees and (2) reasonable allowances for books, school supplies, transportation, clothing and food.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on BASIC EDUCATION since 1998-11-12

rows.manual_status: Approved by the House and transmitted to the Senate on 2001-02-06

rows.mother_status: Approved by the House on 2001-02-05, transmitted to on 2001-02-06 and received by the Senate on 2001
rows.title_full: AN ACT TO PROTECT THE FOREST BY BANNING ALL COMMERCIAL LOGGING OPERATIONS, PROVIDING THE MECHANISMS FOR ITS EFFECTIVE ENFORCEMENT AND IMPLEMENTATION, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.abstract: "Total Commercial Log Ban of 1998". Seeks to BAN commercial logging operations in the country for  THIRTY (30) YEARS to protect the remaining dipterocarp forest and provide time for fast-growing tree species to reach maturity.
rows.status: Substituted by HB12710

rows.author: C044
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS TO APPROPRIATE TEN PERCENT (10%) OF THEIR DEVELOPMENT FUNDS TO SUPPORT THE SOCIAL REFORM AGENDA, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTION 324 OF THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract: Rationale: The annual budgets of LGUs are heavily focused on infrastructure development programs leaving social services and other development programs a second priority. The primary objectives of SOCIAL REFORM should be given equal emphasis.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 1998-11-16

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING THE DEPARTMENT OF FINANCE TO PRESCRIBE A MINIMUM OCCUPANCY RATE AND DAILY ROOM RATE OF MOTELS AND INNS FOR TAX PURPOSES
rows.abstract: Customers of motels and inns have no desire to claim their official receipts as proof of payment. Therefore, taxes or gross due from these establishments easily escape the tax net. With this bill, the Government can collect the much needed revenuesif properly collected.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2000-10-26, transmitted to on 2000-10-26 and received by the Senate on 2000

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 117 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED(RE: PERCENTAGE TAX ON DOMESTIC CARRIERS...)
rows.abstract: The percentage tax on domestic carriers and keepers of garages is set at THREE PERCENT (3%) of their quarterly MONTHLY gross receipts.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-11-16

rows.author: C113
rows.title_full: AN ACT AMENDING SECTION 125 OF THE NATIONAL INTERNAL REVENUE CODE, AS AMENDED(RE: TRANSPARENCY IN THE PAYMENT OF AMUSEMENT TAX)
rows.abstract: Requires TRANSPARENCY in the payment of the AMUSEMENT TA. Requires, therefore, operators of professional basketball, house races, and cock derbies to ADVERTISE the QUANTITY and FACE VALUE OF TICKETS SOLD, together with the results of games, in newspaper of general circulation.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on WAYS AND MEANS since 1998-11-16

rows.author: A040
rows.title_full: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE RATE OF SUBSIDIARY IMPRISONMENT FROM ONE DAY FOR EACH EIGHT PESOS (P8.00) TO AN AMOUNT EQUIVALENT TO THE DAILY MINIMUM WAGE OF A LABORER IN THE NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 39 OF THE REVISED PENAL CODE, AS AMENDED
rows.abstract: If the convict has no property with which to meet the fie stipulated in the decision of the Court on his case, he shall be subject to a subsidiary personal liability at the rate of one day for [each eight pesos] EVERY AMOUNT EQUIVALENT TO THE DAILYMINIMUM WAGE OF A LABORER IN THE NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on REVISION OF LAWS since 1998-11-16

rows.author: A010

rows.abstract: "Charter of the Philippine Tourism Corporation (PTC)."  The proposes Corporation shall be the government agency primarily responsible for the development and promotion of the Philippine tourism industry as a vital component for national recovery growth and progress.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on GOVERNMENT REORGANIZATION since 1998-11-16

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM THE VALUE-ADDED TAX CERTAIN SALE OF SERVICES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE THE TAX REFORM ACT OF 1997
rows.abstract: Sale of services by the following shall be EXEMPT from the VAT: Services rendered by (1) banks, nonbank financial intermediaries, finance companies; (2) actors, talents, singers, radio and TV broadcasters; (3) professional athletes; and (4) registered general professional partnerships.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08791

rows.abstract: The issuance of quedans without the corresponding stock; preparation and submission of untrue and false reports; applying for quedans with crops for harvest the following year, are PROHIBITED.

rows.abstract: "Eradication of Racketeers and Powerful Syndicates Law of 1998". Seeks to further strengthen the administration and enforcement of penal laws against criminal syndicates with provisions, such as: (1) very stiff penalties of imprisonment; (2) consolidation of cases in one court; (3) restitution of property to victims, etc.
